definitions.short: an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod
definitions.full: H796. Ashdodi אַשְׁדּוֺדִי adjective, of a people Ashdodite , ׳הָא singular collective noun Josh 13:3 ; usually plural (הָ)אַשְׁדּוֺדִים 1Sam 5:3 , 6 ; Neh 4:1 , and as feminine adjective אשׁדודיות נָשִׁים 13:23 Kt (Qr אַשְׁדֳּדִיּוֺת ).
